name: directus-extension-publish-toggle-button
description: Directus interface: a Publish/Unpublish toggle for catalog.books.status, replacing the raw enum dropdown. PATCHes status to 'published' or back to 'draft' immediately on click - deliberately does not pre-approve the parent Work, so a Publish click fails loudly (surfacing the database's own rejection) if the Work isn't approved yet.
